reason: Provides agent-facing workspace Python virtual environment management through discovery, creation, package installation, uninstallation, and removal tools using host subprocesses.

summaries.zh: 通过代理工具发现、创建、安装、卸载和删除工作区范围内的 Python 虚拟环境。
summaries.en: Manages workspace-scoped Python virtual environments by discovering, creating, installing into, uninstalling from, and removing them through agent-facing tools.

capabilities: Runs Python, pip, and venv commands through a host subprocess channel
Discovers, creates, modifies, and removes workspace-scoped Python virtual environments
Downloads and installs packages from configured package indexes with mirror and proxy fallback
Reads requirements files and supports package uninstall and editable local installs
Can execute third-party package installation code with host-user privileges
